body: Session 2026-09-24 (composer editor core, live testing). All 21 composer PRs (#170 to #190) merged into feat/composer-editor-core at 9b80901; analyze clean, 2,913 of 2,913 tests pass; main untouched. Live macOS gate testing ran about half the 6.14 scenarios: tables, undo, caret geometry, viewer parity, 100k styling and scrolling pass; keystroke UI time (GP1) and 50k open time (GP5) miss their budgets; real defects found are Ctrl+K doing nothing, a floated-photo drag landing at the note end, and a file-URL-only paste inserting nothing. The committed harness's system-wide input froze the owner's Mac once; testing was rebuilt around in-app input and a hardware-input watchdog. Android was set up (SDK, JDK, NDK installed with approval); the repo's Android build is broken by file_picker 11.0.2 with AGP 9 and builtInKotlin=false, and the composer header sits under the status bar. Four fix agents earlier in this effort logged against this thread although it covers different work. End-to-end testing continues in thread e2e-user-testing (01M3AT2037CMEZXTNM5WEPMM4C); the test kit and plan are at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit.
